input.quote: 13.1 IBM assumes and will assume ownership and MSL assigns and will assign all intellectual and industrial property rights for hardware, software, design and documentation of all Products delivered under this Agreement
input.rationale: Every licence grant in this Agreement runs from us (IBM) to MSL, not to us: § 13.3(a) grants MSL only a royalty-free licence to use IBM confidential information necessary to manufacture Products solely for IBM (with any broader licence requiring a separate signed IBM agreement); the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement §§ 5 and 6 grant MSL a limited licence to use Loaned Programs and to execute Licensed Internal Code; and Appendix A expressly confirms MSL receives no rights in MS Software Images. Searches for any inbound grant ("grants IBM", "license to IBM", royalty-free, perpetual/irrevocable/sublicense) return no licence in our favour, and none is needed because § 13.1/13.2 give us outright ownership plus MSL's assignment of all IP in the Products and of inventions made on Products and IBM processes — a stronger position than the preferred licence terms. Accordingly, the customer-side concerns in this rule (affiliate/contractor coverage, revocability at the Vendor's discretion, successor transferability) are inapplicable, and the restrictive, IBM-favourable grants should not be broadened. Noted only for the record: the § 12.2 continued-licensing mechanic for Loaned Programs binds MSL and is at IBM's discretion, again in our favour.
